purpose: Phase-8A resistance-mechanism catalogue: controlled abstractions of the mechanism CATEGORIES a resistance state may reference, plus the apparent-resistance cause hierarchy that separates true cell-intrinsic resistance from delivery/uptake/target/apoptosis/microenvironment limitations. Mechanisms are qualitative abstractions - NO molecular detail (transporter names, expression levels, mutation identity) is invented; specific molecules appear only in evidence-backed profiles. Every active mechanism carries an evidence + prediction label.

reduced_effective_intracellular_availabi.meaning: Lower effective intracellular drug availability (reduced exposure at the target compartment).

increased_efflux_tendency.meaning: Relative increase in drug efflux tendency (qualitative).

reduced_uptake_tendency.meaning: Relative reduction in cellular uptake tendency (qualitative).

reduced_target_availability.meaning: Target reduction or reduced target availability / altered dependency.

compensatory_survival_signaling.meaning: Compensatory survival-signaling at the pathway-abstraction level.

alternative_pathway_dependence.meaning: Shift to an alternative pathway dependence.

stress_response_adaptation.meaning: Adaptation of the stress response reducing stress-to-apoptosis conversion.

apoptosis_evasion.meaning: Increased effective apoptosis threshold / reduced commitment.

microenvironment_mediated_protection.meaning: Protection conferred by ECM/hypoxia/perfusion/spatial limitation (distinct from intrinsic resistance).

immune_associated_escape_pressure.meaning: Immune-associated escape pressure (requires Phase-7C outputs; UNAVAILABLE in this build).

mixed_or_multifactorial_resistance.meaning: Multiple contributing mechanisms without a single dominant one.

apparent_resistance_hierarchy.rule: The first failing gate (delivery -> uptake -> target -> stress -> apoptosis) explains a weak response as a LIMITATION, not resistance. Only survival despite ALL validated biological pressure, that persists or expands, is consistent with adaptive/acquired resistance. Delivery failure is NEVER labelled acquired resistance.

coefficient_policy.valid_range: mechanism categories are qualitative; per-mechanism modifiers live in their own registries and are bounded in [0,1]
coefficient_policy.source: general tumour drug-resistance biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: category assignment selects which per-mechanism abstraction registry contributes; it does not itself carry a numeric effect.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No transporter/protein/mutation identity or level is stated unless a specific evidence-backed profile supplies it (none in this build).
